description:
Problem. `evidence.check` (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/evidence.py, the first line of `check`) skips every read-evidence check when the verdict lists any defect: `if brief_mode == INLINE or verdict.defects or verdict.decision == DO_NOT_SHIP: return None`. In a follow-up round, `protocol.judge` then counts only defects in the changed files (`counted`) and moves the rest to `outside` (not counted). A verdict of SHIP whose only defect is in an unchanged file is therefore judged SHIP, and the read checks never ran. A reviewer that read nothing (hollow, lazy, or steered by text in the pull request) can pass a file-list follow-up this way. This reopens, for follow-ups, the hollow-success hole that verdict v2 closed. Inline briefs are not affected: they carry the diff and need no read evidence by design.

Required change (settled approach). Pass what the runner needs from the plan (the follow-up's changed set, or the plan itself) into `runner.review`, and skip the read-evidence checks only when `protocol.judge_planned` would not return SHIP: DO_NOT_SHIP, at least one defect counted under the plan's scope, or a prior defect left not fixed. Do not change `protocol.judge`. Fix the matching sentence in docs/operations/oracle-review-v2.md, which defines a verdict that would ship as "no defect and not DO NOT SHIP".

Out of scope. Changing what counts as a read (tracked in oracle-read-evidence-tightening-20261008), the judge's counting rules, inline-brief behaviour, or muse/agy self-attestation (oracle-self-attested-file-list-reviewers-20261008).

Guardrails.
- Never weaken the required `oracle-review` check or the stand-in rule.
- Very-high tier: the shadow workflow runs develop's reviewer code, so this PR cannot test its own fix in CI; verify after merge.
- Worktree: `make worktree-create BRANCH=fix/<slug> WORKTREE_PATH=../BenchBox.wt-<slug>`, then `make agent-write-preflight`. Never write in the primary clone. Identity Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>; no attribution lines; stage explicit paths, never `git add -A`.
- No comments or docstrings (COMMENT-POLICY-001); run `make comment-policy-check`.
- PR flow: `make pr-preflight`, `make pr-open`; merge only after an oracle success review (or an owner-authorized stand-in, see context) of the head and all threads resolved.

Stop condition. If the fix cannot be made without changing `protocol.judge` semantics, stop and report to the owner.

Canary (owner-approved, see context). After merge, open a short-lived canary PR titled with "(do not merge)" to drive a file-list follow-up, then close it unmerged and delete its branch.
